notes:
New: no more allow-local-storage pop-up - OPTiC sets Flash local storage to always allow and locks the file, so a bot can no longer stall behind that permission box
New: minimise to tray, and start in the tray - both off unless you turn them on, and they apply the moment you save
Settings is one page - instructions, licence key, storage and the changelog all moved to where they belong
Groups: Max Hero can now measure Attack, Level or Politics, each with its own threshold
Bots stands out in the sidebar
Licence checks are steadier right after an update
Lower idle CPU on the Dashboard
Requires relaunching your bots: the new script only takes effect when a bot next starts
